notes: Resource evaluation is distinct from imported asset provenance. Null denotes unknown or not applicable, as explained by each record. Dataset-specific licenses take precedence over general website descriptions.

resources.title: Digimouse: 3D Mouse Atlas
resources.origin: USC Biomedical Imaging Group and UCLA Crump Institute for Molecular Imaging
resources.coverage: Whole-body segmented reference; actual separate structures are determined by imported tetrahedral labels.
resources.methodology: Coregistered postmortem CT, PET and cryosection imaging; semi-automated anatomical segmentation; tetrahedral mesh.
limitations: Single postmortem male nude specimen
No female or developmental comparison
Source overview may be more detailed than distributed tetrahedral labels
No physiological validation implied
Native anatomical axis directions need explicit verification before anatomical direction labels or quantitative registration

resources.title: Mouse hindlimb and pelvis segmented surfaces, S1 Figure
resources.origin: Charles JP, Cappellari O, Spence AJ, Hutchinson JR and Wells DJ
resources.coverage: 44 source-labelled surfaces from one right hindlimb and pelvis: 37 muscle-named regions, one tendon and six bony or aggregate regions.
resources.methodology: Iodine-enhanced microCT and segmentation; S1 Figure PRC triangle surfaces decoded and converted to glTF without smoothing, decimation or registration.
limitations: The 37 muscle-named surfaces differ from the paper's reported 39 muscles
Foot, Tibia/Fibula and Fabellae retain aggregate source names
Source coordinates have no accepted registration to Digimouse
Orientation and physical calibration remain independently unverified
One regional specimen does not provide female whole-body or population-average anatomy

resources.title: 3D mouse embryo model: EMA147, Stage TS23, Age E15.0 (est)
resources.origin: University of Edinburgh, eMouseAtlas; Caltech Atlas
resources.coverage: 77 developmental TS23 source surfaces: 76 EMAPA-labelled filenames and one unannotated reference surface; only 68 identifiers match the separate anatomy index.
resources.methodology: Deposited MRI-derived ASCII STL surfaces converted to indexed native-coordinate PLY; all triangles and winding preserved, with generated display normals and no repair or registration.
limitations: Embryonic anatomy is not an adult reference
Physical STL units and an accepted mesh-to-image transform are unknown
Age estimates disagree; no scalar age is selected
Only 68 EMAPA identifiers match the separate anatomy index; no mapping by order is inferred
Only 23 of 77 surfaces meet executed closed-topology checks; defects remain present
No accepted registration to any other reference or physiological validation

resources.title: Mouse Genome Informatics data, annotations, MA and EMAPA ontologies

publication.title: Mouse Genome Informatics: an integrated knowledgebase system for the laboratory mouse

resources.coverage: Curated mouse genetic, expression, phenotype and anatomy annotations; MA adult anatomy and EMAPA developmental anatomy ontologies.
resources.methodology: Literature and database curation; ontology development.
limitations: Not a geometric mesh dataset
Images can have restrictive third-party copyright
Crosswalks from source segmentation labels require individual review
A specific release and citation must be selected before bulk reuse

resources.title: Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework: Allen-CCF-2020 package

license.scope: Allen-CCF-2020 package identified in the source description; not a CC-BY-4.0 grant and not a blanket determination for separate archive releases

resources.methodology: Average reference from serial two-photon tomography; 3D anatomical annotation.

resolution.note: Other CCF archive releases provide additional resolutions; they are not assumed to be the same package.

limitations: Not whole-body anatomy
10 micrometre template spacing includes interpolation from 100 micrometre z-sampling
Selected dataset explicitly uses Allen Institute Terms of Use rather than an unrestricted CC-BY-4.0 license
Registration to Digimouse is not established
Full volume package exceeds the current 5 MB acquisition bound and has not been downloaded
Distinct Allen datasets and software can have different licenses

resources.title: A preclinical micro-computed tomography database including 3D whole body organ segmentations
resources.origin: Institute for Experimental Molecular Imaging, University Hospital Aachen and collaborators
resources.coverage: 225 native and contrast-enhanced whole-body mouse CT scans with organ segmentations; longitudinal observations.
resources.methodology: Native and contrast-enhanced in vivo micro-CT with manual or semi-automatic organ segmentation.

resolution.note: The publication also reports 0.28 mm in acquisition paragraphs; actual selected files must resolve the discrepancy.

limitations: Collection size not measured
Per-file license not established by article license
Segmentation quality varies by organ and contrast protocol
Female nude and tumor-bearing populations must not be treated as generic normal anatomy
Longitudinal scans are not independent biological replicates

resources.title: Computer model of action potential of mouse ventricular myocytes
resources.origin: Physiome Model Repository; model of Bondarenko, Szigeti, Bett, Kim and Rasmusson
resources.coverage: Mouse ventricular cell electrophysiology; no whole-body geometry.
resources.methodology: CellML mathematical model of ventricular action potential and component currents.
limitations: Not a whole-heart mechanical contraction model
Repository availability is not evidence that this application has reproduced results
Equations, parameters, numerical solver, units and independent validation must be reviewed before implementation
No prediction of treatment or disease response is supported by this resource review alone

resources.title: Selected Allen CCF 2017 regional brain OBJ candidates

publication.relationship: reference-framework methods; selected individual files remain uninspected

license.note: No separate unrestricted license for these selected 2017 OBJ files was established; do not transfer licenses from other Allen packages or access software.

resources.coverage: Individual regional brain surfaces with Allen structure identifiers; no whole-body registration.
resources.methodology: Official Allen archive surfaces corresponding to the CCF reference; geometry generation and units require file inspection.
limitations: Individual file sizes and checksums have not been preflighted
Parent and child regional surfaces may overlap
Allen IDs are not Digimouse labels or reviewed MA mappings
A source-specific frame and accepted registration are required before any whole-body overlay
No added geometry or implemented coverage is implied

resources.title: MouseLight Neuron AA1624
resources.origin: HHMI Janelia Research Campus MouseLight Project

publication.relationship: MouseLight project methods, not independent validation of this later deposit

license.scope: Figshare version 1 declares CC BY 4.0. The acquired SWC header directs readers to project Terms-of-Use without spelling out an explicit license.

separateNeuronBrowserTerms.scope: Official terms for material found or downloaded from the MouseLight database and NeuronBrowser.
separateNeuronBrowserTerms.note: The official project Browser terms state CC BY-NC 4.0 and differ from the Figshare CC BY 4.0 declaration. The acquired file header refers to project Terms-of-Use. Applicable scope remains unresolved.

headerTermsReference.statement: The original file requests consultation of project Terms-of-Use when referencing the reconstruction.
headerTermsReference.landingPageReadStatus: Timed out during review; no TLS bypass attempted.

resources.coverage: One reconstructed neuron; not a regional organ mesh, complete cellular atlas or observed synaptic-connectivity graph.
resources.methodology: MouseLight single-neuron reconstruction from light microscopy of sparsely labelled brains; project sources describe Allen-reference registration.

download.format: The acquired SWC body contains valid seven-column numerical records; JSON remains metadata-only and undownloaded.

headerPreflight.interpretation: The initial redirected HEAD failed, but that did not establish a GET failure. A subsequent bounded SWC GET succeeded. Temporary signed URLs are not retained.

initialBoundedAcquisitionPlan.scope: SWC only after resource accounting and rechecking version-specific metadata

download.nextAction: Clarify conflicting source license scope before asset import or redistribution.

limitations: Only the SWC body has been acquired, preserved and checksum-verified locally; JSON remains undownloaded. The SWC is ignored and is not imported, bundled or redistributed by the application.
The header declares C57BL/6J strain and CCFv3.0 annotation space with axis strings. These declarations are not independent anatomical verification or an exact CCF package/date release.
Individual specimen, sex, age, cell type, physical coordinate units and a file-specific transform remain unknown.

Figshare v1 declares CC BY 4.0, while the file header refers to project Terms-of-Use and official NeuronBrowser terms state CC BY-NC 4.0. Import and asset redistribution are deferred pending clarification.
All 5665 recorded radii equal 1; this does not establish measured biological radius or physical units.
Two zero-length source edges remain unchanged. Numerical graph validity is not independent tracing accuracy, synaptic connectivity or functional connectivity.
No registration to Digimouse, EMA147, hindlimb or another application reference is established.
The initial redirected HEAD failure was followed by a successful bounded GET; the historical metadata-only review is preserved separately.
resources.recordCitation: Lay M, Ferreira T and MouseLight Project Team (2024). MouseLight Neuron AA1624. Janelia Research Campus. Dataset version 1. doi:10.25378/janelia.27766452.v1.

bodyAssessment.lineRepresentationLimit: A separate unknown-unit source frame would preserve original coordinates and parent links. Display line width would not represent measured cell diameter; publication remains deferred.

reviewStages.result: Version 1 file metadata and license declarations recorded; HEAD did not establish GET failure.
Original body remains ignored. File header and numerical records assessed; import and redistribution deferred over source-specific licensing conflict.

resources.title: A Whole-Body Musculoskeletal Model of the Mouse: resource candidate

license.note: The article's CC-BY-4.0 license does not by itself establish a license for separate repository meshes or third-party source geometry.

resources.coverage: The pinned main skeletal subtree contains 115 STL filenames; unique anatomical bone coverage and complete-model dependencies remain unverified. Other repository subtrees include rat and embryonic forelimb resources.
resources.methodology: Multi-source anatomical references and digitized skeletal objects with modelled limb muscle paths and Hill-type dynamics.
limitations: No explicit model-asset redistribution grant was established; the project API reports no detected license and no LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE file was found among 962 tree entries
Git LFS pointer sizes are not geometry-object sizes; declared hashes and sizes were not verified against downloaded model bodies
Composite generic model is not measured geometry of the Digimouse specimen, and repository subtrees mix species and developmental stages
Muscle paths and Hill-type modelling do not supply adult segmented muscle volumes
Complete-model minimum dependency size remains unknown; no geometry object was acquired or incorporated

resources.origin: Sabrina Renaud, Léa Amar, Caroline Romestaing, Jean-Pierre Quéré and Renaud Lebrun

license.scope: The repository explicitly licenses all displayed 3D data under CC BY-NC 4.0.

resources.coverage: Two bony labyrinth surfaces from a Swiss laboratory mouse; not a complete skull or skeleton.
limitations: Exact file size, format, checksum, source-file version, acquisition method and resolution were not established
No source geometry was downloaded or incorporated
Different specimen and unknown frame preclude assumed anatomical overlay
Noncommercial terms do not provide an unrestricted commercial redistribution grant

resources.title: NeuroMorpho.Org NMO_130632 standardized mouse neuronal reconstruction
resources.origin: Scala and collaborators; NeuroMorpho.Org Tolias archive

publication.citation: Scala F, Kobak D, Shan S, et al. Layer 4 of mouse neocortex differs in cell types and circuit organization between sensory areas. Nature Communications. 2019;10:4174. doi:10.1038/s41467-019-12058-z.

requiredAttribution: Scala F, Kobak D, Shan S, et al. Layer 4 of mouse neocortex differs in cell types and circuit organization between sensory areas. Nature Communications. 2019;10:4174. doi:10.1038/s41467-019-12058-z.
Tecuatl C, Ljungquist B, Ascoli GA. Accelerating the continuous community sharing of digital neuromorphology data. FASEB Bioadv. 2024;6(7):207-221. doi:10.1096/fba.2024-00048.

license.scope: The NeuroMorpho.Org terms apply CC BY 4.0 to downloaded material and request the original paper, NeuroMorpho.Org RRID:SCR_002145 and Tecuatl et al. (2024).

resources.coverage: One independent source reconstruction record with 11,650 sample rows and 11,649 declared parent links; no whole-brain cellular coverage, reconstructed cell surface or accepted anatomical overlay.
resources.methodology: Source-declared in vitro biocytin neuronal reconstruction. The standardized SWC numeric records are retained without sample removal, graph repair, unit conversion or shrinkage correction.

specimen.interpretation: Source categories and ranges do not identify individual sex or exact age; these declarations are not independently verified.

modifications: Removed all original comment headers and blank lines from the distributable adaptation.
Retained numeric token spelling, original row order, sample IDs and parent IDs; normalized field separators and LF line endings.
Retained original numeric coordinates, radii and type codes without repair, unit conversion or shrinkage correction.

limitations: This is one source reconstruction record, not whole-brain cellular coverage or a measured cell surface.
Source physical units, anatomical axes and independent calibration remain unverified; no physical unit conversion is applied.
No original-to-standardized transform or registration to another application reference is verified.
Source radii and type codes remain numeric metadata; line width is a display setting, not a calibrated diameter.
Parent links and numerical graph components do not establish synapses, biological connectivity, cell counts or physiological validation.
Source sex Male/Female and age range 50 to 330 days do not establish individual sex or exact age. Strain and mass remain unknown.
The source reports 15 percent shrinkage without correction. No correction is applied.
Initial Float32 diagnostics exclude later display recentering and GPU arithmetic and do not estimate physical accuracy.
